audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition; draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea, open door, lukewarm warning, beloved discipline, throne promise.

verses.restored: To the messenger of the assembly in Sardis write: These things says the One having the seven Spirits of the Divine and seven stars. I know your works, that you have name that you live, and you are dead.

familiar.text: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

verses.restored: Become awake and strengthen the remaining things that were about to die, for I have not found your works completed before my Divine.

familiar.text: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

verses.restored: Remember therefore how you received and heard; keep it and turn/realign. If you do not wake, I will come like thief, and you will not know what hour I come upon you.

familiar.text: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

verses.restored: But you have a few names in Sardis who did not soil their garments; they will walk with me in white, because they are worthy.

familiar.text: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

verses.restored: The one conquering will be clothed thus in white garments, and I will not wipe one's name from scroll of life, and I will confess that name before my Father and his messengers.

familiar.text: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

verses.restored: The one having ear, hear what Spirit says to the assemblies.

familiar.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

verses.restored: To the messenger of the assembly in Philadelphia write: These things says the Holy One, the True One, having key of David, opening and no one will shut, shutting and no one opens.

familiar.text: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

verses.restored: I know your works. Look, I have given before you an opened door that no one is able to shut, because you have little power and kept my word and did not deny my name.

familiar.text: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

verses.restored: Look, I give from the assembly of the adversarial one, those saying they are Judeans and are not but lie; look, I will make them come and bow before your feet and know that I loved you.

familiar.text: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

verses.restored: Because you kept the word of my endurance, I also will keep you from the hour of testing about to come upon the whole inhabited world, to test those dwelling upon earth.

familiar.text: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

verses.restored: I come quickly. Hold what you have, so that no one takes your crown.

familiar.text: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

verses.restored: The one conquering, I will make that one pillar in the temple of my Divine, and one will never go out; and I will write upon that one the name of my Divine, and name of city of my Divine, the new Jerusalem coming down from heaven, and my new name.

familiar.text: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.

verses.restored: The one having ear, hear what Spirit says to the assemblies.

familiar.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

verses.restored: To the messenger of the assembly in Laodicea write: These things says the Amen, the trustworthy and true witness, the beginning/source of the creation of the Divine.

familiar.text: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

verses.restored: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

familiar.text: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

verses.restored: So, because you are lukewarm and neither hot nor cold, I am about to spit you from my mouth.

familiar.text: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

verses.restored: Because you say, I am rich and have prospered and need nothing, and you do not know that you are wretched and pitiable and poor and blind and naked,

familiar.text: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

verses.restored: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire so you may be rich, and white garments so you may be clothed and shame of your nakedness not manifest, and eye-salve to anoint your eyes so you may see.

familiar.text: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

verses.restored: As many as I love, I expose and discipline; therefore be zealous and turn/realign.

familiar.text: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

verses.restored: Look, I stand at the door and knock; if anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will enter to that one and eat with that one and that one with me.

familiar.text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

verses.restored: The one conquering, I will give to sit with me on my throne, as I also conquered and sat with my Father on his throne.

familiar.text: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

verses.restored: The one having ear, hear what Spirit says to the assemblies.

familiar.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

translation_notes: Philadelphia's 'Judeans and are not' language is local conflict rhetoric and must not become anti-Jewish theology.
Laodicea is critiqued for self-sufficient wealth blindness; invitation is table fellowship.
Discipline language is love/exposure/turning, not abuse.
safety_note: Do not weaponize assembly diagnoses against modern churches or people; they are symbolic pastoral calls to wake, endure, open, and turn.
